page.summary: The old automated consistency pairing is historical. Use the manual skill-check strategy if you want a current route to repair value.
whatItWas: Players paired Stake Out with Hyperfocus so converted checks could help sustain the repair engine without demanding the same run of manually hit Great checks.
Its appeal was consistency: the supporting interaction reduced how much of the payoff depended on the player's own check accuracy.
whyNotCurrent: The researched 10.2 change invalidated that interaction: the relevant special Skill Checks no longer activate other Skill Check perks. Equipping the familiar pair does not restore the old engine.

Treat an older recommendation of this pairing as historical advice. Stop building around automated consistency; assess whether you can execute the manual successor instead. Current perk links show current mechanics, not the former interaction.

successors.why: Manual Skill-Check Generator keeps the repair goal but asks you to hit compatible basic Great checks yourself. Choose it for that execution challenge, not as a promise of the old consistency; if you cannot sustain the checks, do not keep investing in the invalidated pairing.

historicalPerks.historicalUse: Historically supplied converted checks that made the paired repair engine more forgiving. This explains the old recommendation; it is not a claim that current special checks feed the other perk.
Historically supplied the escalating skill-check payoff that players tried to sustain with the pairing. The current manual successor must earn that consistency through compatible checks.
